nodes.label: AI Generated Demo Image - Fashion Model
nodes.description: AI-generated fashion photography demo image showing a female model in a casual outfit: white crew-neck t-shirt, blue slim-fit denim jeans, and white low-top sneakers. Model is posed walking forward against a clean white studio background. Image style is professional e-commerce product photography quality. A small four-pointed star sparkle is visible in the bottom-right corner, indicating AI generation. Intended to demonstrate the platform's AI fashion image generation capability on the landing page.
